enable_lan_session.description: Enable the opt-in SafeCoop Tailscale session for this copied test save.

host_address.description: Tailscale IPv4 address of the host PC. The PC with this address hosts automatically.

session_port.description: SafeCoop Tailscale port. Both players must use the same value.

session_code.description: A private code of at least 8 characters. Both players must use the same code.
